newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks edge up, dealers expect downside.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks edge up, dealers expect downside.

text.p: Caracas stocks ended the week slightly higher, but brokers expected some profit-taking to appear next week.

The IBC capitalization index rose 43.57 points (0.65 percent) on Friday to close at 6,696.64 points, with 20 shares showing gains, 18 down and seven unchanged. A total of 25.2 million shares changed hands worth 4.2 billion bolivars ($8.86 million).
"The market went up a little but volumes were low," said one broker.

"I think you have to be cautious about next week," said another. "I am expecting some profit-taking particularly in Electricidad de Caracas shares which have gone up quite a bit and I would be cautious about CANTV because of the strike threat."
However, another dealer doubted whether the strike threat would affect CANTV. "We have been living with the threat for three weeks," he said.
CANTV workers on Thursday threatened an indefinite strike if the company did not improve on recent wage offers.
